quizGuardRationale: Author judgments for independent assessment, not reviewer findings. Direct ordinary meanings and actual answer labels govern; exclusions are symmetric and nontransitive. Reused declarations remain unchanged.
執筆 guards writing/authoring/composition on 書く/著す/作文, not automatically every author, published text, record or rough-draft noun.
実物 guards 本物/物/本当 real-thing/object/real labels; actual thing and genuine article overlap without erasing their Japanese distinction.
しっぽ guards 尻/終わり/末/端/先/最後 end/rear/tip meanings from its additional end sense, not every body part or future-time sense.
実用 guards 使用/利用/用/使う/応用/活用/役に立つ use/application/usefulness meanings. 実際 actuality, 便利 convenience and 実行 execution do not automatically form a practical-use clique.
実力 guards 能力/力/才能/腕/技術/学力 actual capacity, strength and skill meanings, including 腕's explicit secondary skill use. It is not automatically past performance/results or every evaluation of competence.
実例 guards 例/例え/サンプル example/sample meanings. It does not inherit every typical/representative answer through those cards.
失恋 guards 失望/がっかり broad disappointment labels in romantic failure. 別れる and 悲しい are distinct separation/sadness propositions, not automatically heartbreak answers.
指定 guards 指す/決める/選ぶ/選択/決定 designation/settling/selection meanings. 指導, entrusting, reservations and commands are not automatic equivalents.
私鉄 guards broad 鉄道 railway label, not every vehicle, underground mode, iron material or public institution.
縛る guards 結ぶ/締める/繋ぐ tie/fasten senses and 制限/限る freedom-restriction senses. Rope/string substances are not themselves binding actions.
地盤 guards 地/土地 ground/land, 基盤/基礎 supporting foundation and 台/基地 base meanings. Geographic region/district alone is not an electoral support base.
しびれる guards びりびり/ぴりぴり/じんじん/ちくちく tingling sensations and 感動/ぞくぞく deep emotional thrill. Pain and actual sleeping are different states.
紙幣 guards 札/お金/金/現金 banknote/money/cash meanings, not notebook, paper substance, invoices or the contrasting coin form.
しぼむ guards 枯れる plant withering; limp cooked food and disappearing generally are not loss-of-fullness synonyms by category.

絞る guards 締める tightening, 減らす/下げる range/volume reduction, 叱る scolding and 訓練 training. 押す's broad push is not treated as a direct wringing answer, nor does specialized sumo immobilization require blanket 押さえる protection.
